pages.text: Rain kept them indoors today. Bung and Ddori sat beneath the awning. Behind them, Grandpa dried a wet oar.
Ddori's mouth drooped. Bung wanted a smile. "I will make you laugh!"
Bung tickled Ddori's tummy. Ddori giggled.
Bung tickled harder. Ddori laughed and twisted.
Ddori pushed Bung's hands away with both hands. Bung thought that meant more fun.
The laughter stopped. Ddori shoved those hands away and turned around.
Hic, hic! Ddori had hiccups. Bung hid both hands behind the back.
Grandpa gently held Bung's wrist. "Let go."
Bung stayed still. Ddori tugged at Bung's arm.
Bung hugged Ddori snugly. Face on Bung's shoulder, Ddori smiled softly.
